title: From Conventional Sludge-Production Models to Population-Integrated Physics-Informed Neural Networks: A Technical Note on Proposed Conceptual Framework
authors: Asef Mohammad Redwan, Sakib Hossain Parvez, Puspita Das
abstract: A conceptual technical note presenting a physics-informed neural network (PINN) architecture integrating biological population dynamics with mass-balance constraints to enhance the predictive accuracy and optimization of wastewater sludge digestion and bioprocess control.
